annotations.title: Check an image against marketplace rules

description: Check an image's width, height, format and file size, and its declared main-image background and product fill, against a platform's published rules (Amazon, eBay, Etsy, Shopify, Walmart and others). Returns pass, the failing rules, notes, the rules that need the photo itself, and a link to fix the image. Use it when the dimensions are known; it never sees the photo, so background and fill are only as declared. When the photo is at a public https link, use check_image_url instead.

background.description: Main-image background as seen in the photo: pure-white (RGB 255), white (off-white), light (light grey or neutral), coloured (plain colour), busy (scene or texture), transparent.

file_size_bytes.description: File size in bytes; without it the file size limit is not checked.

product_fill.description: Share of the frame the product covers on its longest axis, 0 to 1 (0.85 = 85%).

name: check_image_spec

outputSchema.description: Verdict against the platform's published rules.

message.description: The rule and the image's value in one English sentence.

rule.description: Rule key, for example format, fileLarger, shortUnder, bg-pure-white, fill-min, whole, square.

fix_url.description: Where to fix a failing image; null when nothing fails.

not_checked.description: Rules that could not be checked from the input, with the reason.

message.description: The rule and the image's value in one English sentence.

rule.description: Rule key, for example format, fileLarger, shortUnder, bg-pure-white, fill-min, whole, square.

notes.description: Warnings that do not fail the image, such as recommendations and zoom size.

pass.description: True when no checked rule fails; see not_checked for what was not checked.
